BETA Close X Bellway PLC has announced the completion of further share purchases under its ongoing buyback program, acquiring a total of 112,849 ordinary shares between August 10th and August 14th, 2026, at a volume-weighted average price of 2,151.24 pence per share, with the highest price paid being 2,194.00 pence and the lowest at 2,084.00 pence. These shares will be cancelled, bringing the total purchased under the first and second tranches of the program to 6,474,668 shares, resulting in a new total of 112,838,300 ordinary shares in issue. Disclaimer* Bellway PLC 17 August 2026 Bellway p.l.c. Transaction in Own Shares 17 August 2026 Bellway p.l.c. ('Bellway' or the 'Group') announces that, in accordance with the terms of the share buyback programme (the 'Buyback Programme') announced on 14 October 2025 and the terms of the Second Tranche announced on 2 April 2026, from 10 August 2026 up to and including 14 August 2026 the Group purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 12.5 pence each (the Ordinary Shares') through Deutsche Bank AG. Date Number of shares purchased Highest price paid (GBp) Lowest price paid (GBp) Volume weighted average price (GBp) Trading venue 10 August 2026 9,000 2,130.00 2,088.00 2,108.39 XLON 11 August 2026 14,671 2,110.00 2,084.00 2,097.58 XLON 12 August 2026 40,000 2,166.00 2,138.00 2,152.74 XLON 13 August 2026 8,178 2,180.00 2,138.00 2,153.22 XLON 14 August 2026 40,000 2,194.00 2,170.00 2,178.65 XLON The purchased Ordinary Shares will be cancelled. Since the announcement of the Second Tranche of the Buyback Programme on 2 April 2026, Bellway has purchased 3,516,352 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for cancellation. Bellway has now purchased 6,474,668 Ordinary Shares under the first and second tranche (to date) in aggregate for cancellation under the Buyback Programme. Following settlement of the above purchases and cancellation of the purchased ordinary shares, the Group's total number of ordinary shares in issue shall be 112,838,300 ordinary shares. In accordance with Article 5(1)(b) of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 as it applies in the UK (the Market Abuse Regulation), the table below contains detailed information of the individual trades made by Deutsche Bank AG on behalf of Bellway as part of the Buyback Programme.
